;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)]] 
**A [[suicide attack]] by [[car bomb]] in [[Galkayo]], [[Somalia]], kills at least seven civilians, though the death toll is expected to rise according to military officials. According to a military spokesman, the suicide bomber tried to enter a hotel compound but failed and hit a military pickup. No group has claimed responsibility yet. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attack-galkayo/suicide-bomb-outside-somali-hotel-kills-at-least-seven-military-idUSKBN1YP0KT (Reuters)]
*[[Islamic insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)]], [[Operation Barkhane]]
**During his visit to [[West Africa]], [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] says that French forces killed 33 [[Islamism|Islamist]] militants in central [[Mali]] earlier that day. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/21/french-forces-kill-33-islamic-extremists-in-mali-says-macron (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]], [[Libya–Turkey relations]]
**The [[Libyan Coast Guard]] loyal to [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]] seizes a [[Grenada]]-flagged ship with a [[Turkish citizen|Turkish]] crew off the coast of [[Derna, Libya]], according to a spokesman for the [[Libyan National Army]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-turkey/eastern-libyan-forces-seize-ship-with-a-turkish-crew-spokesman-idUSKBN1YP0LW (Reuters)] 

;Business and economy
*[[Nord Stream 2]] says it will finish construction "as soon as possible" after a contractor suspends pipe-laying work due to U.S. sanctions on the Russian gas pipeline to Europe. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-russia-nord-stream-completion/nord-stream-2-to-press-on-with-europe-gas-pipe-despite-u-s-sanctions-idUSKBN1YP061 (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] reach a new five-year agreement on gas transit. [https://apnews.com/5025492604b2378ef41e5e040351814c (AP)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A fire at an apartment building in [[Las Vegas]], [[Nevada]], [[United States]], kills six people and injures thirteen others. [https://www.reviewjournal.com/local/local-las-vegas/6-dead-in-downtown-las-vegas-apartment-fire-1919071/amp/ (''Las Vegas Review-Journal'')]
*A bus collides with a truck near [[Gualán]], [[Guatemala]], killing at least 21 people including seven children, according to the [[Ministries of Guatemala|Guatemalan Public Ministry]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/12/21/americas/guatemala-bus-crash/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Pakistan]], [[Blasphemy in Pakistan]], [[Capital punishment in Pakistan]]
**A court in [[Multan]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]], sentences [[university]] [[professor]] [[Junaid Hafeez]] to death for [[blasphemy]] – verbal and on [[Facebook]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/pakistani-academic-junaid-hafeez-sentenced-death-blasphemy-191221091139428.html (Al Jazeera)] 
*The [[Royal Canadian Mounted Police]] arrest two suspects after they allegedly made online [[death threat]]s to [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]. Trudeau had to wear a [[bulletproof vest]] during a visit to [[Mississauga, Ontario]], due to the threats made during his electoral campaign. [https://ca.news.yahoo.com/rcmp-arrests-2-alleged-online-184209881.html (Yahoo! News Canada)]
